maml:description.maml:para: Reads a security descriptor from a remote file or directory.

Security descriptor sections to retrieve (default: Owner, Group, DACL).
Return a System.Security.AccessControl security descriptor (Windows only).
Literal target path. Use when the path contains wildcard characters.
Return the security descriptor as an SDDL string.

Returns the security descriptor as a Windows access control object.
